tutorial.title: How PodFinder works
tutorial.step1.title: Set up your profile
tutorial.step2.title: Search for a pod
tutorial.step2.body: Hit the LFG button, pick your settings, and you're live.
tutorial.step3.title: Browse or get requests
tutorial.step3.body: Find a pod to join, or accept players into your own on Active Pods.
tutorial.step4.title: Get notified
tutorial.step4.body: The bell keeps you posted on requests and updates.
tutorial.step5.title: Connect and play
tutorial.step5.body: Add each other on Discord, then mark your pod as matched.
tutorial.networkEffect.title: The more, the better
tutorial.networkEffect.body: PodFinder gets better the more people use it, more pods, more matches, less waiting. Tell your playgroup!

cantStartSearchDialog.title: You're already in a group
cantStartSearchDialog.body: You can't start a new search while you have a pending request on (or have joined) someone else's pod. Leave that pod first, from its card in the match feed, if you want to search for a different group.
confirmMarkMatchedDialog.title: Got everyone on Discord?
confirmMarkMatchedDialog.body: Marking as matched removes this pod from the match feed for good. Make sure you've added everyone via Discord's Add Friend search (copy their handles from the Group Members list) before you continue.
confirmRemoveMemberDialog.title: Remove {name}?
confirmRemoveMemberDialog.body: They'll be dropped from the group and free up a spot. They can request to join again afterwards if you change your mind.
matchedDialog.title: You're Matched!
matchedDialog.body: The host marked this pod as matched. Check your Discord DMs, the host should be reaching out (or sending a friend request) shortly. Also don't be surprised when its card disappears from the match feed, it's been removed now that the group is set.
noUsersFoundDialog.title: No one's found this pod yet
noUsersFoundDialog.body: It's been a while and no one has requested to join, so it's stopped showing up in the match feed. Unlist it, or keep searching to put it back in front of other players.
